I_ACCESS.description: Reviews report being unable to access an account or having a password rejected.

I_BILLING.description: Reviews object to features such as choosing, skipping, or queuing songs being restricted to Premium.

I_CATALOG.description: Reviews mention missing songs or lyrics, changing recommendations, and limited music selection.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Reviews report downloads getting stuck and offline listening not working.

I_OTHER.description: Reviews express general dissatisfaction with the app without describing a specific problem.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Reviews report playback interruptions, connection trouble, crashes, loading failures, and malfunctioning music adjustment.

I_SUPPORT.description: A review expresses dissatisfaction with the app's support team.

I_USABILITY.description: Reviews mention frequent ads, unwanted shuffle behavior, removed player features, and difficulty navigating playlists or albums.
